description.value: Tofino Licks is an artisanal soft-serve ice cream shop in Tofino that collaborates with local restaurants and bakeries — Tacofino, Sobo, Common Loaf, and the Tofino Ucluelet Culinary Guild — to create uniquely topped sundaes using ingredients from the town's culinary scene. Their Italian-imported soft serve and sorbets are prepared in-house, with both creamy vanilla gelato and a vegan chocolate sorbet as bases. It's a well-known local stop for a sweet treat after a ride on Vancouver Island's west coast.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 50m; stands (2 spaces) at 61m; stands (20 spaces, covered) at 63m. Total: 24 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business is an artisanal soft-serve ice cream shop at 511 Campbell Street (suite 130) in Tofino, with phone 250-703-1349. The site explicitly describes vegan options including dairy-free chocolate sorbet and vegan peanut butter bar. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in the OSM tags, so those all remain null.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only so contact_confirmed is null for those fields. Website copyright reads 2017 but content appears current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active ice cream shop in Tofino with a live website and confirmed contact details; a natural stop for cyclists touring the area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website explicitly describes vegan chocolate sorbet ('dairy free and vegan'), vegan berry sauces, and a vegan peanut butter chocolate oat bar topping
